1: // Minimal endless‑runner for canvas with id "game"
2: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
3: if (!canvas) throw new Error('Canvas #game not found');
4: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
5: // Audio setup
6: const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
7: const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
8: function playTone(freq, duration) {
9:   const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
10:   const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
11:   osc.frequency.value = freq;
12:   osc.type = 'sine';
13:   osc.connect(gain);
14:   gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
15:   gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
16:   osc.start();
17:   osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
18: }
19: canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
20: canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
21: 
22: // Game parameters
23: const GRAVITY = 0.6;
24: const JUMP_VELOCITY = -12;
25: const PLAYER_SIZE = 30;
26: const SCROLL_SPEED = 4;
27: const OBSTACLE_WIDTH = 20;
28: const OBSTACLE_GAP = 150; // distance between obstacles
29: 
30: let player = { x: 50, y: canvas.height - PLAYER_SIZE, vy: 0, width: PLAYER_SIZE, height: PLAYER_SIZE, onGround: true };
31: let obstacles = [];
32: let frameCount = 0;
33: let gameOver = false;
34: 
35: function spawnObstacle() {
36:   const height = Math.random() * (canvas.height / 2) + 20;
37:   const type = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'spike' : 'low'; // spike: tall, low: short bar
38:   const obs = {
39:     x: canvas.width,
40:     y: type === 'spike' ? canvas.height - height : canvas.height - PLAYER_SIZE - 10,
41:     width: OBSTACLE_WIDTH,
42:     height,
43:     type,
44:   };
45:   obstacles.push(obs);
46: }
47: 
48: function update() {
49:   if (gameOver) return;
50:   // Player physics
51:   player.vy += GRAVITY;
52:   player.y += player.vy;
53:   if (player.y >= canvas.height - PLAYER_SIZE) {
54:     player.y = canvas.height - PLAYER_SIZE;
55:     player.vy = 0;
56:     player.onGround = true;
57:   } else {
58:     player.onGround = false;
59:   }
60: 
61:   // Obstacles movement and removal
62:   obstacles.forEach(o => (o.x -= SCROLL_SPEED));
63:   obstacles = obstacles.filter(o => o.x + o.width > 0);
64: 
65:   // Spawn new obstacles
66:   if (frameCount % Math.round(OBSTACLE_GAP / SCROLL_SPEED) === 0) spawnObstacle();
67: 
68:   // Collision detection
69:   for (const o of obstacles) {
70:     const hit =
71:       player.x < o.x + o.width &&
72:       player.x + player.width > o.x &&
73:       player.y < o.y + o.height &&
74:       player.y + player.height > o.y;
75:     if (hit) { gameOver = true; playTone(150, 0.3); break; }
76:   }
77:   frameCount++;
78: }
79: 
80: function draw() {
81:   // background gradient
82:   const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
83:   grad.addColorStop(0, '#87ceeb'); // sky blue
84:   grad.addColorStop(1, '#e0f7fa'); // light cyan
85:   ctx.fillStyle = grad;
86:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
87: 
88:   // No need to clear; gradient already fills background
89:   // ground line
90:   ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
91:   ctx.fillRect(0, canvas.height - 5, canvas.width, 5);
92:   // player
93:   ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
94:   ctx.fillRect(player.x, player.y, player.width, player.height);
95:   // obstacles
96:   ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
97:   obstacles.forEach(o => ctx.fillRect(o.x, o.y, o.width, o.height));
98:   if (gameOver) {
99:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
100:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
101:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
102:     ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
103:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
104:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
105:   }
106: }
107: 
108: function loop() {
109:   update();
110:   draw();
111:   if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
112: }
113: 
114: // Input – tap/click to jump
115: canvas.addEventListener('click', () => {
116:   // Ensure audio context is running
117:   if (audioCtx.state !== 'running') audioCtx.resume();
118:   if (player.onGround) {
119:     player.vy = JUMP_VELOCITY;
120:     playTone(300, 0.1); // jump sound
121:   }
122: });
123:   if (player.onGround) player.vy = JUMP_VELOCITY;
124: });
125: canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
126:   e.preventDefault();
127:   if (player.onGround) player.vy = JUMP_VELOCITY;
128: });
129: 
130: // Start game
131: requestAnimationFrame(loop);
